title: Initial evaluation, right shoulder after painting

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Good afternoon, Helen. Tell me about the right shoulder.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I painted the hallway ceiling two weeks ago and it's been sore since. Pain is 5 out of 10 at rest now.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Reaching up for a cup in the cupboard hurts, like a sharp catch.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Can you reach your hand behind your back to your back pocket?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: I measured shoulder flexion at 130 degrees on the right, versus 165 on the left.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Abduction strength on the right is 3+/5, and the left is 5/5.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: It hurts when I push against your hand, yes.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Are you sleeping on that side?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I can't lie on it. I've been sleeping in a recliner.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Assessment: the shoulder is stiff and weaker than the left, and reaching overhead is limited. I want to hold off on overhead exercises for now.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Plan: start gentle pendulum swings and table slides twice a day. We'll reassess in two weeks.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Can I still do light cleaning on the weekend?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Keep it light, and use your left arm for high shelves for now.

expectedFacts.statement: Reaching up for a cup hurts, like a sharp catch
Shoulder flexion 130 degrees on the right
Shoulder stiff and weaker than the left
Pendulum swings and table slides twice a day
